name: bradens-unity-skills
description: Braden's Unity skills for Claude Code, forked from Quin Henshaw's quins-unity-skills 0.7.0: VFX Graph effects from texture packs, PlayMode tests through real input devices, selective asset pack extraction, 3D model icon rendering, keeping a CLI-driven Editor unblocked, an in-game debug menu with a CLI mirror, Steam Deck builds and a task clarification interview. Adds hooks that enforce checkable project rules: no em or en dashes, no legacy Input or MaterialPropertyBlock in C#, --project-path on unity command, and commit checks for Unity cache folders and files over 10 MB.
